Use SQL to query catalog.

## Synopsis

```text
sqlquery
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Reads SQL statements interactively and prints their results; an empty line ends the input.

## Examples

Enter SQL statements ending with a semicolon, an empty line leaves the mode:

```text
sqlquery
```
